void-black.$description: Void Black — Page canvas, hero backgrounds, full-bleed sections

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Card surfaces, elevated panels, content containers above the page

carbon.$description: Carbon — Secondary surface layer, input fields, nested containers

graphite.$description: Graphite — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

slate.$description: Slate — Subtle violet-tinted surface for spotlight/featured cards

ash.$description: Ash — Hairline borders and dividers, very low-contrast separation

steel.$description: Steel — Slightly stronger borders, subtle outer shadow tint

fog.$description: Fog — Muted helper text, disabled labels, low-priority metadata

smoke.$description: Smoke — Secondary icons, inactive navigation items, tertiary text

cloud.$description: Cloud — Body text secondary, link text in resting state, icon strokes

silver.$description: Silver — Body text default, paragraph copy, description text

bone.$description: Bone — Captions, fine print, decorative text

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Primary headings, button text on dark fills, high-emphasis text

signal-violet.$description: Signal Violet — Brand accent — highlighted phrases, feature body text, link emphasis, inline brand moments

live-wire.$description: Live Wire — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

circuit-teal.$description: Circuit Teal — Decorative icon and illustration accent — network node strokes, lock/connection diagrams, graphic highlights

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

tt-hoves-light.$description: Display and headline — all large hero/section headlines (48–68px) use weight 300 with tight negative tracking (-0.018em to -0.007em). The whisper-weight at huge sizes is the brand's signature: confidence through restraint, not volume.

tt-hoves-medium.$description: Subheadings, feature card titles, navigation, button labels — the workhorse of the system. 32px appears as a mid-tier section heading, 20px as card titles.

tt-hoves-regular.$description: Body text and long-form copy — paragraph text at 16px with generous 1.5–1.7 line-height, smaller annotations at 11–14px

basis-grotesque-mono-pro.$description: Code snippets, terminal-style text, and technical labels — used sparingly as a technical accent, never for body copy

inter.$description: Secondary body text and supporting UI labels (appears as a fallback/supplement to TT Hoves Regular in some contexts)
